title: Validate collaboration cache entries
responsibility: Key cached bytes by validated project and source identity and discard entries that fail integrity checks.

inputs.name: cacheKey.identity
inputs.description: Principal, project, repository and source revisions with nullable evidence, notes, artifact and profile selectors.

inputs.name: readCache.cache
inputs.description: Cache adapter from which to read or delete an entry.

inputs.name: readCache.identity
inputs.description: Expected identity for the cached bytes.

inputs.name: writeCache.cache
inputs.description: Cache adapter into which to store the entry.

inputs.name: writeCache.identity
inputs.description: Validated identity to bind to the stored bytes.

inputs.name: writeCache.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to hash and copy into the cache; must match artifactHash when supplied.

outputs.name: cacheKey
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized identity JSON.

outputs.name: readCache
outputs.description: A copy of verified bytes, or null for a miss or a corrupt entry that was deleted.

outputs.name: writeCache
outputs.description: Stores normalized identity, SHA-256 and copied bytes; resolves without a value.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The internal corrupt-cache error is caught and turns into deletion and a null result; adapter failures may still propagate.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid identities or an artifact hash mismatch on write.
